spec_match.rationale: The four call shapes are exactly the ones PR 12898 distinguishes (safe default, safe + explicit true overridden by removeUnsafe, unsafe + explicit false, unsafe default), and the diff table audits the spec's navigating URL attributes.

interactive.rationale: Editable markup, a radio call-shape selector, and a run button that performs the real setHTML/setHTMLUnsafe call and diffs input vs output attributes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the four real call shapes with a per-attribute diff and navigation-disabled preview; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the removeUnsafe override, the ignored-unknown-dictionary-member trap (detected via an element-allowlist side effect, never reported as support), and suppresses the preview when output is unsanitized.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5169798320357376, the HTML Standard anchor, and PR 12898.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the method surface, canonicalisation defaults, setter return contract, removeUnsafe override, and both behavioural branches with a sanitizer-ran proof; all 9 executed on the conformance route (0 pass / 9 fail on Chromium 141, honestly).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): clicked Run on safe-default and unsafe-strict shapes at 1280×800 and 360×740; verdict showed the real TypeError (Overload resolution failed) and the labelled per-spec table appeared; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts sanitizer-jsurls-run on verified runs, sanitizer-jsurls-option-ignored on the ignored-member branch, and sanitizer-jsurls-absent-branch (TypeError) on the no-API branch; intentional console logging only.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, button sets background and color together, verdict/status colours use the darker emerald for AA on paper.

accessibility.rationale: Radio group in fieldset/legend, labelled textarea, aria-live verdict, keyboard-focusable table region with caption, visible focus-visible outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow (0px measured), 44px controls, legible text; screenshots of both classes read.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the real-run path on a Chrome 157 build
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in the verification environment predates the Sanitizer API (ships 146) and this option (157), so only the honest fallback branches could be exercised end-to-end. When a 157+ binary is available, run all four call shapes and confirm the diff table shows removed javascript: attributes on shapes 1-3 and kept on shape 4, and that the conformance suite flips to 9 passes.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML safely setHTML Sanitizer API
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use setHTML() as the primary insertion path, feature-detect with 'in' checks, and never serialize-and-reparse sanitized nodes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: setHTML/setHTMLUnsafe are the only insertion paths; detection uses 'setHTML' in Element.prototype and 'setJavascriptURLs' in Sanitizer.prototype; the preview moves live nodes with replaceChildren instead of reparsing.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Browser-support data in the guide (Sanitizer from Chrome 146) matches the observed absence on Chromium 141.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates live region aria-live announce result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface changing state through text in a polite live region with accessible names on controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdict paragraph is aria-live=polite; every control has a visible label; results table has a caption and keyboard-focusable scroll region.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing and wrapping so panels never overflow narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Textarea and tables use box-sizing/overflow-wrap and a scrollable table wrapper; 0px horizontal overflow measured at 360px.

summary: Runs the exact four call shapes from PR 12898 against the real API with a per-attribute diff, proves sanitizer execution via an allowlist side effect before attributing results to the new option, and degrades to real exceptions plus a labelled per-spec table on pre-146 browsers. Verified in headless Chromium 141 at both viewport classes with clean console and no overflow.
